info.title: Amrutam Telemedicine System API
info.description: RESTful API documentation for Amrutam Telemedicine System, built with Express.js, Knex, and PostgreSQL.

bearerAuth.description: Enter JWT bearer token for authorization.

get.summary: Search and filter Ayurvedic doctors with sub-200ms latency SLA
get.description: High-performance doctor search engine with composite filtering, next-available-slot calculation, and Redis caching.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keyword search matching doctor's name, specialization, or bio

parameters.name: specialization
parameters.description: Ayurvedic specialization (e.g. Kayachikitsa, Panchakarma, Shalya Tantra)

parameters.name: availableDate
parameters.description: Filter doctors who have available slots on this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

200.description: Search results with pagination and next available slots

get.summary: List all active Ayurvedic categories with doctor counts and fee stats
get.description: Aggregated clinical specialties with average fees, fee ranges, and ratings cached in Redis.
